name: TeamStarWolf - Mapping Completeness
description: Rule: Every live ATT&CK Enterprise technique is in the layer; the score counts which of five library mappings it has (0 to 5): an ATT&CK mitigation, a NIST SP 800-53 control, a CAPEC pattern, a D3FEND countermeasure and an ATT&CK detection strategy. Each technique is shown under all of its tactics. Generated by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py.
